title: Sine Rule Forms
text:
The Sine Rule has two forms:

**For finding sides:** $$\frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B} = \frac{c}{\sin C}$$

**For finding angles:** $$\frac{\sin A}{a} = \frac{\sin B}{b} = \frac{\sin C}{c}$$

title: Choosing the Right Form
text:
Since we want to find side b, we need the unknown (b) in the numerator. Use:
$$\frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B}$$

title: Confirm the Formula
text: The correct form is: $$\frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B}$$
